## Selected work

### Cable Manager (thesis project, 2026)

Role: Full-stack developer. Source code is not public (built for a real client); walkthroughs on request.

Billing and subscriber management for a local cable and internet provider. One set of records, reached three ways:

- Office system: a single Windows installer (Inno Setup) that bundles Apache 2.4, MariaDB 10.4 and PHP 8.2. Runs on one office computer with no internet connection and nothing else installed.
- Subscriber portal: an installable web app where subscribers see bills, report payments and follow their requests to the office.
- Android app: native Kotlin with Jetpack Compose. Reminders, QR payment, PDF receipts, connection tests. Keeps the last answer it was given, so it still shows a balance when the office computer is off.
- Remote access: Tailscale Funnel gives the portal and app a permanent HTTPS address with no router configuration.

Notable engineering:

- Atomic restore: takes a safety copy, refills tables inside one transaction, and refuses wrong, truncated or newer backups before touching anything. Automatic backup on every start, thirty kept.
- Sign-in throttling per account and per address on all three entry points, with doubling lockouts up to 30 minutes and an audit trail.
- Four roles (administrator, bookkeeper, staff, subscriber) enforced server-side. Prepared statements, CSRF tokens, bcrypt, hashed and expiring app tokens.
- 11 automated test files with no dependencies; each run rebuilds a throwaway database.
